news_cards.title: Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS)
bullets: Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS) ka upyog karke sabhi Central Ministries, Departments, States aur Union Territories ek hi platform par connect hain.
CPGRAMS ke madhyam se 1 August 2026 tak 1,23,111 shikayen samadhaan ki gayi hain.
CPGRAMS ka upyog karke sabhi shikayenon ka samadhaan karne ke liye ek hi platform par sabhi vyavasthaon ko connect kiya gaya hai.

news_cards.title: Anti-snake venoms to be available in 108 ambulances in A.P.
bullets: Andhra Pradesh mein 108 ambulances mein anti-snake venoms (ASV) available karne ka nirnay liya gaya hai.
A.P. mein 108 ambulances mein ASV available karne se snakebite ke case mein patienton ko immediate treatment mil sakta hai.
A.P. Health Minister Satya Kumar Yadav ne kaha hai ki A.P. mein snakebite ke case mein emergency calls badh rahe hain.

news_cards.title: Manipur government announces reopening of National Highways
bullets: Manipur government ne National Highways ko reopen karne ka nirnay liya hai.
Manipur mein National Highways ko reopen karne se sabhi samudayon ke logon ko free movement mil sakta hai.
Manipur government ne Nagaland ke capital Kohima aur Manipur ke capital Imphal ke beech bus service ko bhi shuru karne ka nirnay liya hai.

news_cards.title: TPCC likely to get four working presidents as Congress weighs social balance
bullets: Telangana Pradesh Congress Committee (TPCC) mein chaar working presidents ki naye nirnay ki sambhavana hai.
Congress high command ne TPCC leadership structure ko badalne ka nirnay liya hai.
AICC ne TPCC mein social aur rajneetiya balance ko banaye rakhne ke liye chaar working presidents ki naye nirnay ki sambhavana hai.

news_cards.title: El Nino may trigger 39% rainfall deficit this season: Naidu
bullets: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu ne kaha hai ki El Nino ke karan is season mein 39% rainfall deficit ho sakta hai.
El Nino ke karan Andhra Pradesh mein rainfall 39% kam ho sakta hai.
El Nino ke karan Andhra Pradesh ke reservoirs mein paani ki sthiti bhi badh sakti hai.

news_cards.title: Andhra CM directs officials to make Jaladhara-Jalaharathi continuous programme
bullets: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu ne Jaladhara-Jalaharathi programme ko continuous programme banane ka nirnay liya hai.
Jaladhara-Jalaharathi programme ko continuous programme banane se Andhra Pradesh mein paani ki sthiti mein sudhar hoga.
Jaladhara-Jalaharathi programme ko continuous programme banane ke liye Andhra Pradesh ke officials ko nirdesh diya gaya hai.
